pie_de_post: Send this to that friend who always says he has no time.

slides.etiqueta: “I don't have time”: the excuse that's costing you your health

slides.texto:
A week has 168 hours.
3 workouts of 45 minutes is 2.25 hours. 1.3% of your week.
It's not a lack of time. It's a lack of priority.

Monday, Wednesday, Friday. 45 minutes. Heavy basics.
If it's on the calendar, it happens. If not, it doesn't exist.

Walking calls. Stairs. Park farther away.
You don't need an extra hour: you need to move in the hours you already have.

Cook protein for 3 days at once. Repeat breakfasts.
Fewer decisions = more consistency.

The people who work the most need energy, focus and a clear head the most.
Taking care of yourself doesn't cost time. It multiplies it.

Every week I share how to optimize your hormones after 30, without living in the gym.
